description: Every reserve of the Aera money market: total supplied / borrowed / available, utilization, supply and borrow APR (projected to the current slot), caps, origination fee, collateral terms (loan-to-value, liquidation threshold, bonus, haircut), the share token (aCOOK / abCOOK) and its exchange rate, and each oracle's health. Only `borrowEnabled` reserves can be borrowed (COOK) and only `collateralEnabled` ones can back a loan (bCOOK). No key needed.
name: get_lending_markets
title: Aera lending markets
